BiblicalUsage: Chacan is an Aramaic word for holding, possessing, occupying. Daniel is told the saints of the Most High will take the kingdom and possess it for ever, even for ever and ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kingdom is not rented by the saints — it is theirs to hold, for ever.
